content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: B.E./B.Tech./M.E./M.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, Electronics, Electrical, Instrumentation or relevant allied discipline. Age limit: Maximum 35 years (on the closing date of application) Other conditions: The engagement is temporary and co-terminus with the project. The selected candidate will work under the supervision of the Principal Investigator. The selected candidate shall comply with institutional, laboratory safety, confidentiality and project requirements. Desirable: Knowledge/experience in CAD/CAE, embedded systems, sensors and data acquisition, MATLAB/Simulink, fabrication, programming and research/project work.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Initial duration is one year May be extended based on satisfactory performance, project requirement and availability of funds Does not confer any right to regular/permanent appointment in CSVTU

content_sections.heading: How Will CSVTU Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting of eligible candidates Interview by a duly constituted Selection Committee Selection will be made through an interview by a duly constituted Selection Committee.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Updated CV/Resume Educational qualification certificates and marksheets Proof of Date of Birth/Age Relevant experience/research/project documents, if applicable

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSVTU Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Get the application form: Google Form Link provided in notification. Fill in the form and attach the documents listed above. Apply on or before 10 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: At the time of interview, bring the copy of self-attested copies of Date of birth Certificate, Degree/Provisional Certificate along with Marks Memos, Caste Certificate, No Objection Certificate, other testimonials, and Original Certificates for verification. No travelling or any other allowances is admissible for attending the interview.
